name: Verity Arrowrest
description: Seat the draw as a hawk settles on its perch and find the two lines of the shot.

name: Berserk Release
description: Draw to the high anchor and hold within the field for a steep falling shot.

name: Facet Snapshot
description: Draw to the low anchor beside the jaw for a flat fast shot under a guard.

name: Perceptive Bowstring
description: Spread the field upward to read the angle at which an arrow will fall onto a mark.

name: Drawruin
description: Loose a steep arrow from the high anchor that stoops onto a foe's shoulders.

name: Glint Riser
description: Loose a flat skimming arrow along the ground at a runner's shins.

name: Overpowering Draw
description: Send one arrow high and one low so both pin a foe's cloak and boot at once.

name: Tempered Loose
description: Drive a stooping arrow with field force through a plate and the man within.

name: Rumblelimb
description: Gather the field through a long draw and loose two arrows that stoop together onto one mark with hawk force.

name: Vigilant Limb
description: Share a count with a partner so both draws reach full at the same beat.

name: Might Nock
description: Settle the stance on low ground and spread the field so a partner stays in its edge.

name: Siltlimb
description: Slide to clear the partner's line of fire without breaking the draw.

name: Nova Anchor
description: Turn the draw to face the partner's blind side and loose at a foe closing on it.

name: Equipoise Serving
description: Link the qi field with a partner's string so both draws feel the same tension.

name: Facet Limbtip
description: Loose two arrows that cross in flight to strike one mark from different angles.

name: Facet Quiver
description: Hold the bow across the partner's body with the field forming a veil against arrows.

name: Mangling Bowgrip
description: Draw together and loose a spread from two bows that overlap on one wide patch of ground.

name: Vanes Wrath
description: Send one arrow to open a shield and the partner's arrow into the gap.

name: Granite Bowstring
description: Gather both fields in one hold and loose paired arrows that drop on a whole company in the basin.

name: Gust Anchor
description: Draw to the same pace as a slow river and hold within the field without strain.

name: Chime Vanes
description: Slip the nock from quiver to string as if on a current with no pause.

name: Phantom Release
description: Walk along a bank at the pace of the current while keeping the draw ready.

name: Shadevanes
description: Loose arrows in a steady rolling stream at one ground so it never has an empty moment.

name: Gust Limb
description: Turn the body like an eddy and loose an arrow at a flanking foe in the turn.

name: Glamour Volley
description: Loose arrows into a patch of ground so the dust and splinters cloud a foe's sight.

name: Nova Bowgrip
description: Loose an arrow that curves along the field like a river bend to strike a foe behind a corner.

name: Silt Quiver
description: Gather the field and loose a heavy sheet of arrows that pours across a wide patch like a flood.

name: Hour Volley
description: Gather the field in one hold and loose a stream that runs unbroken and holds a whole line down.

name: Vanesinsight
description: Lift the eyes into the azure and read the distance by the clarity of the light.

name: Loose Devastation
description: Draw to full length within the field and hold for the far mark.

name: Limbhavoc
description: Raise the aim for thin high air and loose a hardened arrow to a very distant mark.

name: Silt Limbtip
description: Take a steadying step forward as the field settles on the mark and the draw is loosed.

name: Arrowrest Havoc
description: Lift the arrow with field force along its long arc so it falls hard at the end.

name: Suffocating Nock
description: Send an arrow across the reach to pin a banner or sleeve to a distant post.

name: Rampaging Serving
description: Loose a long steady stream across a great span to hold a column on its road.

name: Tempered Riser
description: Loose a field-driven arrow along a high line to pierce shield and plate at great range.

name: Eviscerating Limbtip
description: Gather the field in a long hold and loose an arrow that falls steeply with spear force.

name: Novariser
description: Gather the whole field in a very long hold and loose one arrow that pierces the guard of a distant leader.

name: Illuminating Arrowrest
description: Feel the upper limb's bend through the field and note its share of the load.

name: Discerning Nock
description: Feel the lower limb's bend through the field and balance it against the upper.

name: Gustriser
description: Draw so each limb takes half the qi load and loose with an even release.

name: Snapshot Devastation
description: Release both limbs in one snap so the arrow leaves faster than any single draw.

name: Murk Serving
description: Use the two limbs together to catch a blade between them and turn it.

name: Gyvelimb
description: Hook a limb tip behind a foe's knee or wrist and wrench him off line.

name: Booming Quiver
description: Release both limbs with field force in the shaft and pierce a shield and what lies behind it.

name: Glamour Limb
description: Catch a thrown spear on the limbs and send it back along its line by the bow's rebound.

name: Rending Loose
description: Gather qi in both limbs and loose a single arrow with the spring of two bows behind it.

name: Bowgrip Premonition
description: Spread the field upward to sense the currents above a perch before the draw.

name: Limbglare
description: Settle on a narrow high perch and spread the field to stand steady.

name: Loosehavoc
description: Aim above a target in the air and loose with an allowance for its drift.

name: Blaze Bowstring
description: Loose an arrow steeply upward at a rider on a high wall or flying foe.

name: Release Wrath
description: Loose an arrow that glances off stone and strikes a foe sheltering at the base.

name: Obdurate Quiver
description: Spin the bow and field to turn a volley aside as it rises.

name: Quiverruin
description: Gather the field and loose arrows from a perch in a wide spread over a courtyard.

name: Glint Vanes
description: Send an arrow along the upper air to pierce the guard of a target atop a high wall.

name: Facet Volley
description: Gather the field in a high hold and loose a shaft that falls from the upper air with great force.

name: Verity Bowstring
description: Run one stream of qi in each arm and match their flow before the draw.

name: Chime Anchor
description: Draw with the bow-arm stream flowing outward and hold as the string-arm stream draws in.

name: Gnashing Serving
description: Loose as the two streams meet at the string and the force of both leaves in the arrow.

name: Granite Draw
description: Step on the meeting of the streams to keep the shooting line steady.

name: Quivervalor
description: Turn a blade aside with a stream running down the bow arm.

name: Booming Riser
description: Loose an arrow charged by both streams so it hits with doubled force.

name: Snapshot Ruin
description: Loose arrows in two streams that diverge to hold two parts of a line.

name: Chime Bowgrip
description: Run the two streams through the field to sense a foe's pulse and breath.

name: Facetanchor
description: Send an arrow with both streams behind it to open a shield and carry through.

name: Granite Riser
description: Gather both streams in one hold and loose arrows in a wide spread.

name: Ruinous Anchor
description: Merge the two streams in the draw and loose a single arrow with the full force of both rivers.

name: Facet Arrowrest
description: Draw with the whole meridian network open and hold the draw with no strain.

name: Loose Ruin
description: Nock and loose along two tracks of qi in the arms with no pause between shots.

name: Nock Slipstream
description: Set a deep stance that locks the shoulders and hips against a heavy string.

name: Ruinous Limb
description: Pour qi from the meridian network into the shaft for a hard flat shot.

name: Murknock
description: Parry with the stave along one track and loose along the other.

name: Gyvenock
description: Pin two points of a foe's clothing at once with paired arrows.

name: Novavolley
description: Send an arrow along the meridian network's full force to pierce a shield and plate.

name: Downpour Volley
description: Gather qi in a paired draw and loose a wide spread of arrows.

name: Blistering Limbtip
description: Gather the whole meridian network in a long hold and loose one arrow with two tracks of qi behind it.

name: Riservigil
description: Take the bearing of a far mark with the whole field before lifting the bow.

name: Blaze Vanes
description: Draw as the oath is spoken, hold to the last word and loose.

name: Siltvolley
description: Step along the bearing line to keep the mark in the field's eye.

name: Vanesscourge
description: Loose an arrow that holds the bearing through a crosswind to a far mark.

name: Beneficent Vanes
description: Spread the field across a plateau to read the shifts of the wind.

name: Snapshot Valor
description: Pin a rider's saddle cloth to the ground at long range along the bearing.

name: Anchorruin
description: Send an arrow along a locked bearing with the wind at its back to pierce plate.

name: Dismantling Draw
description: Gather the field and loose arrows that spread on the wind across a wide stretch of ground.

name: Punishing Bowgrip
description: Hold a long bearing through a gale and loose one arrow whose force carries the whole oath.

name: Prescient Limbtip
description: Speak the oath word and take the stance as the host does, in one voice.

name: Rumbleriser
description: Draw with the line at the call and hold until the second call.

name: Might Release
description: Step with the gust along the line so the rank stays even.

name: Murkvanes
description: Turn the stave to cover a sworn neighbor in the line from a flung blade.

name: Charter Nock
description: Loose arrows on the sworn word in a single rolling volley across open ground.

name: Buoying Bowstring
description: Share the field's reading of the wind with the line so all aim alike.

name: Shattering Draw
description: Loose from the line as a comrade draws to keep a foe's head down.

name: Mangling Quiver
description: Loose on the oath word with the wind behind the shaft to pierce a shield wall of boards.

name: Silt Arrowrest
description: Gather the field and loose with the line a spread of arrows that darkens the sky.

name: Dismantling Volley
description: Hold the line's oath through one long draw and loose a shaft that sunders a mass of foes.

name: Remnant Serving
description: Hold the string slack and feel the wind's pull through the field before the nock.

name: Novaquiver
description: Draw while turning the field to the wind's heading and hold.

name: Limbwrath
description: Count the gusts through the string and loose on the quiet beat.

name: Lacerating Snapshot
description: Loose an arrow that bends with the wind to strike a foe behind cover.

name: Reverie Limb
description: Send a whistling arrow across a foe's face to draw the eye and break his aim.

name: Ponderous Release
description: Loose a stream of arrows that fall on the downwind side of a position.

name: Vengeful Draw
description: Send an arrow that rides the gale and falls with extra weight on a shield.

name: Slag Bowstring
description: Gather the field and loose arrows that spread on the wind across a wide zone.

name: Searing Anchor
description: Read the gale in one long hold and loose a single arrow along the bearing the wind itself sets.

name: Farseeing Limb
description: Spread the field wide on open ground to feel for any foe closing from any side.

name: Glintlimb
description: Draw while walking in the open with the field holding the string true.

name: Ghosting Vanes
description: Pace with the wind so the line to the mark does not change.

name: Unassailable Riser
description: Crouch low with the bow before the body and let the field take the first shot.

name: Riserwrath
description: Turn mid-step and loose at a foe who has come in from the side.

name: Quiverhavoc
description: Loose a wide stream of arrows that covers a half circle of ground.

name: Fastening Snapshot
description: Pin a foe's cloak to open ground as he runs past.

name: Rumble Loose
description: Send a field-driven arrow in the open air through the guard of a mounted foe.

name: Downpour Anchor
description: Gather the field and loose arrows that fall in a ring around the archer in all directions.

name: Facetvanes
description: Gather the field in a hold in open air and loose a shaft that tears through a foe in the open.

name: Remnant Bowgrip
description: Take a bearing by the sun and wind and set it in the field as the oath requires.

name: Ruinous Volley
description: Draw while speaking the sworn word and hold until the word ends.

name: Merciless Arrowrest
description: Loose along the kept bearing with no slip of the grip.

name: Chime Serving
description: Loose an arrow whose flight is bound to the bearing and does not stray in wind.

name: Intent Quiver
description: Loose arrows from the plateau edge onto a slope in a steady rain.

name: Intentriser
description: Loose an arrow, then at the oath word call it back on a cord to be loosed again.

name: Gnashing Draw
description: Send a heavy arrow along the kept bearing with qi to pierce a shield.

name: Brutalizing Nock
description: Speak the oath in a long hold and loose a spread of arrows that fall on the wind.

name: Facet Loose
description: Hold the bearing and the oath in one long draw and loose a single arrow that does not miss its mark.

name: Remnant Vanes
description: Hold the bow arm straight and feel the wind part around it.

name: Hoarfrost Snapshot
description: Draw with the arm as an edge into the wind and loose at the lull.

name: Meteoric Quiver
description: Step along the edge of the wind to close or open the range in one stride.

name: Volleyruin
description: Swing the qi-edged bow limb across a foe's throat at close range.

name: Murk Limbtip
description: Turn the stave edge into a blade to slide it away.

name: Thornriser
description: Pin a foe's sleeve at close range with an arrow shot past the bow arm's edge.

name: Hellish Bowgrip
description: Loose an arrow along the wind's edge with qi in the head to pierce plate.

name: Downpour Riser
description: Gather the field and loose arrows that fan out along the wind's edge.

name: Punishing Release
description: Gather the field in a hold and loose one arrow whose edge parts the air and the guard.

name: Limbblink
description: Plant the feet and sink the field through a gale that lasts hours.

name: Anchorscourge
description: Hold full draw against a gale while the field takes the strain.

name: Revitalizing Arrowrest
description: Count the beat of the gale's gusts by the oath's rhythm.

name: Volleyscourge
description: Loose on the quiet beat between gusts with a thread of the gale's force in the shaft.

name: Drawscourge
description: Loose arrows on the gale's push in a long stream across a wide plain.

name: Iron Limbtip
description: Form the field into a veil behind the bow to ward off wind-borne arrows.

name: Lancing Limb
description: Loose an arrow on the gale's push with enough field force to pierce plate.

name: Nockwrath
description: Gather the field in a long hold and loose arrows that the gale spreads over a wide area.

name: Staggering Draw
description: Gather the gale in the field and loose arrows with its whole force over an armed company.

name: Release Havoc
description: Draw with the whole meridian network open and speak the oath through the hold.

name: Gnashing Nock
description: Nock along the bearing of the wind with the network feeding the draw hand.

name: Silt Serving
description: Step with a deep stance that the gale cannot move.

name: Rumble Bowstring
description: Pour qi from the network into the shaft for a hard flat wind-riding shot.

name: Chime Bowstring
description: Parry along the oath's line and loose in the same breath.

name: Overpowering Anchor
description: Pin two points of a foe's gear with paired arrows on the bearing.

name: Tempered Volley
description: Send an arrow with the network's full force along the bearing to pierce plate.

name: Blaze Riser
description: Gather qi and loose a wide spread of arrows that fall on the wind.

name: Hollowriser
description: Gather the whole meridian network in a long hold and loose one arrow carrying the full oath of the open wind.
